verdict.rationale: Dover documents its own bulk actions for applying one change to many candidates. Its docs also refer to interview stages that feedback forms attach to, and say candidates are moved along the pipeline. The core configurable-pipeline elements of the story are not evidenced. Missing for 10: custom stages configurable per job, drag-to-move candidates between stages (kanban), bulk actions explicitly spanning the whole pipeline, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, I run configurable hiring pipelines — custom stages per job, drag-to-move candidates, and bulk actions across the whole pipeline

citations.quote: Bulk actions let you apply the same change to many people at once, instead of opening each profile.
Create a form once, assign it to an interview stage, and every interviewer scores candidates the same way.
It uses the booking to move the candidate along, prompt interviewers for feedback, and send reminders.
